reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: OWN-11 owns interrupt atomics and notification bits while libc retains image-lifetime handler targets and temporary action structs stay on stack.
owner_creation.invariant: Kernel callback registrations borrow stable code addresses.
limitations: OWN-11 handler registration owns no snapshot of application data.

aliases_escapes.analysis: OWN-11 handlers access interrupted filter, queue and screen owners; those raw aliases are not retired by an event-loop borrow protocol.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Interrupted owner aliases are not yet protected by dispatch.
limitations: Interrupted filter and queue owners remain raw handler-visible aliases.

callback_targets.analysis: OWN-11 registers u_interrupt, stop, lwinch, terminate, sigalarm and sigusr1; sentinel values still cross Rust function-pointer representations.
callback_targets.invariant: Real code targets and signal sentinel values remain distinct concepts.
limitations: Signal error/default sentinels are not ordinary C handler targets.

invalidation.analysis: OWN-11 handoff replaces dispositions but does not reverse any filter or queue mutation already performed by an interrupting handler.
invalidation.invariant: Handoff must retire callbacks before changing their owners.

mutation_commit.analysis: OWN-11 masks signals around read/ppoll notification checks; direct handler side effects and sigs updates remain separate unguarded commits.
mutation_commit.invariant: Atomic read wakeup does not make all handler mutations atomic.

release_pair.analysis: OWN-11 restores masks and wait counters through Rust guards, while terminate/filter handlers may release storage used by suspended callers.
release_pair.invariant: Handler-triggered release remains an explicit open hazard.
limitations: Restoring a signal mask cannot retire a suspended raw pointer.

error_cleanup.analysis: OWN-11 lacks typed signal error values and reentry-safe owner cleanup; failed registration or asynchronous quit cannot be assumed recovered.
error_cleanup.invariant: Error cleanup cannot be assumed reentry-safe.

signals_handoff.analysis: OWN-11 defers some resize/job-control work but retains the four open M0-SIG hazards for filter, queue, termination and sentinel handling.
signals_handoff.invariant: This cycle is hazard-recorded, never signal-safe approved.
limitations: This is source review of current registrations, wakeup and callback lifetime; it does not close job-control, callback-provider or independent review gates.
